chunks: These are the verses of the sagacious Book,

key_terms.الْحَكِيمِ: The Wise (possessing deep wisdom and discernment)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran describe itself as in the opening of Surah Luqman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the Quran as *Al-Kitab Al-Hakim*, emphasizing that its wisdom (*Hikmah*) is not merely rhetorical but a source of practical guidance and discernment. It serves as a preamble to Surah Luqman, where the divine wisdom is concretely illustrated through the advice given to Luqman’s son, linking the text's authority to its utility in moral and spiritual life.
